name: My AI Skill Tutor
description: Helps working professionals find the AI-era job their experience fits and prove it in public: a free career map from a résumé, a public library of career routes, and Proof Studio (a public site, a voice model tuned in context on the person's own writing, and a build log), plus role-based learning modules, a 24/7 AI tutor and daily AI news.

skills.name: Career Map
skills.description: Free, no account. Turns a pasted or uploaded résumé (PDF, DOCX or TXT), or a description of a past job, into a new AI-era job title, two alternates, skill translations each tied to a résumé line, the gaps and a three-piece proof plan. A starting hypothesis, not a hiring prediction. Results are private links at /map/{token}.

skills.name: Remapped
skills.description: Public library of career routes, one new route every Monday. Each route shows an old job, the AI-era title it maps to, skill translations, gaps, a first project and what stays hard.

skills.name: Proof Studio
skills.description: Part of the Career Builder plan ($49.99/month, 7-day free trial, card required). Builds three public proof pieces: a site at /u/{handle}, a voice model tuned in context (voice profile plus examples, not fine-tuned) that visitors compare with the untuned base model, and build log posts at /u/{handle}/log/{slug}. Nothing is public until the user publishes it.

skills.name: Public Proof Pages
skills.description: Per-user public pages with a new title, skill translations, things built, a voice model comparison and build log posts.

skills.name: AI Skills Assessment
skills.description: Anonymous assessment that recommends which AI skills a professional should build first.

skills.name: AI Upskilling Guides
skills.description: Public editorial guides on building AI skills, changing careers, portfolios and career proof.

skills.name: Talent Directory
skills.description: Public directory of published proof profiles.

pricing.trial: 7-day free trial, card required to start, no charge if cancelled before the trial ends
